integrity: Exact finite-field proof and independently enumerated small-prime-field examples; no external independent review, formal proof certificate, or performance claim beyond the stated model.
scientific_limitations: The exact count assumes uniformly sampled fixed-cardinality positive task sets, distinct messages, a fixed negative query, and noiseless uniform evaluation. It does not apply unchanged to deterministic task families or noisy channels. Established general tuple-support-enumerator methods may imply portions of the distribution after specialization; priority is not independently certified.
